title: Dynamics 365 Contact Center: customer-first direct callback with callback profiles
summary: Hold: the queue configuration route omits a required selection, and the enablement control is labelled tenant-wide without supporting documentation. Microsoft also documents administrator roles covering the app's configuration entries, so the role guidance should not present this as wholly unpublished.

claims.where: front matter: defaultState; summary; Why it matters; rationale: risk
claims.claim: Customer-first direct callback requires administrator enablement rather than starting automatically.
claims.quote: Save the profile. After you save the first profile, the system enables customer-first direct callback and makes the profile available for queue configuration.

claims.claim: The enablement toggle is at Copilot Service admin center > Routing > Callback management > Customer-first direct callback.
claims.quote: In the site map of Copilot Service admin center, go to Routing > Callback management. ... After provisioning completes, select the Customer-first direct callback toggle.

claims.claim: Microsoft has not documented an API equivalent for the customer-first direct callback enablement toggle.
claims.quote: Searched: "customer-first direct callback" enable API organization settings table; "customer-first" "callback" "msdyn" enable organization table API. Opened configure-customer-first-callback and msdyn_proactive_callback_config; the latter does not identify its Enabled column as this toggle.

claims.claim: The enablement control has tenant-wide scope.
claims.quote: Searched: "customer-first direct callback" "tenant" "environment". Opened configure-customer-first-callback, cs-admin-center and msdyn_proactive_callback_config; none states that this toggle governs all environments in a tenant.
claims.fix: Set controls[0].scope to "other" and remove the rendered "Tenant" label; the feature documentation does not establish tenant-wide enforcement.

claims.where: summary; controls[0].note; Why it matters; Risk assessment; Governance controls; rationale: risk
claims.claim: Enabling customer-first direct callback cannot be undone.
claims.quote: After you enable customer-first direct callback, you can't disable the feature.

claims.where: Why it matters; Risk assessment; Governance guidance: Before rollout; rationale: risk
claims.claim: The first profile automatically applies to queues already using direct callback as an overflow action.
claims.quote: During initial setup, the first callback profile automatically applies to queues that already use direct callback as an overflow action.

claims.claim: Once customer-first direct callback is enabled, administrators cannot revert to classic direct callback.
claims.quote: If you enable customer-first direct callback, it becomes the default callback experience and you can't revert to direct callback.

claims.claim: Enable Copilot AI agent for callback management under Routing > Callback management before selecting the customer-first toggle.
claims.quote: In the site map of Copilot Service admin center, go to Routing > Callback management. ... Enable Copilot AI agent for callback management.

claims.claim: The administrator must wait for Callback Agent provisioning before selecting the customer-first toggle.
claims.quote: Wait for the system to provision Callback Agent and verify that it provisions the agent without errors. ... After provisioning completes, select the Customer-first direct callback toggle.

claims.claim: At least one callback profile is required to enable the feature.
claims.quote: You can't enable the feature until you create at least one callback profile.

claims.claim: Saving the first callback profile completes enablement.
claims.quote: After you save the first profile, the system enables customer-first direct callback and makes the profile available for queue configuration.

claims.claim: Callback profiles are configured through Copilot Service admin center > Routing > Callback management.
claims.quote: In the site map of Copilot Service admin center, go to Routing > Callback management. ... On Create new direct callback profile, enter the following details:
claims.fix: Keep the documented route, but replace controls[1].note's first sentence with: "The route reaches Callback management; profile creation continues on Create new direct callback profile, then Dialing and Behaviors > Retry Settings."

claims.claim: POST /msdyn_proactive_callback_profiles creates a callback profile configuration record.
claims.quote: Configuration entity for callback profiles used in direct and scheduled callback scenarios. ... Create ... POST /msdyn_proactive_callback_profiles
claims.fix: Keep the call and append to controls[1].note: "The request body can set msdyn_callback_offering_windows for offering windows, msdyn_callback_phone_number for the outbound number, msdyn_number_of_retries for retry attempts, and msdyn_fallback_action for fallback behaviour."

claims.claim: The queue route goes directly from Overflow handling to Before work items are queued > Add condition-action pair.
claims.quote: Under Overflow handling, select Add condition-action pair. ... In the Overflow handling page, in Before work items are queued, select Add condition-action pair.
claims.fix: Replace controls[2].ui.path with "Customer support > Queues > Advanced queues > queue > Overflow handling > Add condition-action pair > Before work items are queued > Add condition-action pair". The first Add condition-action pair opens the Overflow handling page and must not be omitted.

claims.claim: PATCH /msdyn_overflowactionconfigs(msdyn_overflowactionconfigid) updates the overflow action configuration that carries the callback profile lookup.
claims.quote: Update ... PATCH /msdyn_overflowactionconfigs(msdyn_overflowactionconfigid)

claims.claim: The Customer Service extension supplies the writable msdyn_proactive_callback_profileId lookup for associating the profile.
claims.quote: Lookup to the Callback Profile associated with overflow action config ... LogicalName: msdyn_proactive_callback_profileid ... ReferencingEntityNavigationPropertyName: msdyn_proactive_callback_profileId

claims.claim: Classic direct callback assigns the request to a representative before calling the customer.
claims.quote: In the classic direct callback experience, the system assigns a callback request to a representative before it calls the customer.

claims.claim: In classic direct callback, the representative waits while the customer call attempt completes.
claims.quote: If the customer doesn't answer, the call reaches voicemail, or the number is unavailable, the representative waits while the call attempt completes.

claims.where: summary; What's changing; Risk assessment: Autonomy & actions
claims.claim: Customer-first direct callback calls the customer first when the request reaches the front of the queue.
claims.quote: With customer-first direct callback, the system calls the customer first when the callback request reaches the front of the queue.

claims.claim: At least one representative must be available when the system initiates the callback.
claims.quote: When the callback request reaches the front of the queue and at least one representative is available, the system initiates the callback.

claims.where: summary; What's changing; Why it matters; Risk assessment
claims.claim: The representative joins after the customer answers and completes any required verification.
claims.quote: After the customer answers and completes any required verification, the system connects the customer to an available representative.

claims.claim: An AI agent can verify the customer before transfer to a representative.
claims.quote: An AI agent can engage the customer, collect information, or perform verification. ... The system transfers the customer to an available representative.

claims.claim: The AI agent can collect information before a representative joins.
claims.quote: An AI agent can engage the customer, collect information, or perform verification.

claims.claim: Verification is optional per profile, with an informational-message profile as an alternative to a verification profile.
claims.quote: For example, a profile can require customer verification before the call is connected, while another profile can play an informational message before the transfer.

claims.where: What's changing; Governance guidance: Before rollout; controls[1]
claims.claim: A callback profile configures the initial callback offer message.
claims.quote: Initial callback offer: Edit the default message that the system plays when customer opts for a callback.

claims.claim: A callback profile can ask the customer for an alternate callback number.
claims.quote: Ask for alternate number: Select to call customers at a number of their choice.

claims.where: What's changing; Governance guidance: Before rollout; controls[1]
claims.claim: A callback profile can define a callback offering window.
claims.quote: Callback offering window: Turn on the toggle to define when the system can offer callback requests.

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment: Data exposure; Governance guidance: Before rollout
claims.claim: Profile duplicate prevention identifies existing callback requests using the customer's phone number.
claims.quote: The system performs duplicate detection only when the overflow action triggers a direct callback experience. It uses the customer phone number to identify existing callback requests.

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment: Change & support; Governance guidance
claims.claim: Queue allocation configures the maximum number of active callback requests per queue.
claims.quote: Queue allocation: Specify the maximum number of active callback requests that a queue can hold.

claims.claim: When the queue allocation limit is reached, callers continue through the standard queue experience.
claims.quote: When the queue reaches the configured limit: The system stops offering callbacks. Customers continue through the standard queue experience.

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment: Security & identity; Governance guidance; controls[1]
claims.claim: The profile configures the outbound callback number.
claims.quote: On the Dialing page, in Callback number, select one of the following options to determine the number from which callback is offered.

claims.claim: The profile selects the Copilot Studio agent that engages customers after connection.
claims.quote: AI agent: Select the Copilot Studio agent that handles customer engagement after the callback connects.

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment: Autonomy & actions; Governance guidance
claims.claim: When the agent cannot engage the customer, fallback options are prompt and hang up or prompt and escalate.
claims.quote: Fallback action: Select one of the following options and customize the prompt and prompt message if agent is unable to engage with the customer: Prompt and hang up; Prompt and escalate

claims.where: What's changing; Governance guidance: After rollout
claims.claim: Profile rules delay new callback attempts when average callback wait time exceeds the configured threshold.
claims.quote: The system continuously monitors recently dialed callbacks and, when the average wait time exceeds the configured threshold, automatically delays new callback attempts.

claims.where: What's changing; Governance guidance: After rollout; controls[1]
claims.claim: Retry settings cover no answer, failed and answering-machine outcomes.
claims.quote: On the Behaviors page, in Retry Settings, select the retry options to configure the behavior for the following triggers: No answer; Failed; Answering machine

claims.claim: The minimum retry wait is five minutes.
claims.quote: Wait time: Select the duration in minutes or hours to wait before retrying. The minimum duration is five minutes.

claims.claim: Direct callback requests close automatically after seven days.
claims.quote: The system automatically closes direct callback requests after seven days.

claims.claim: One callback profile can be configured per overflow condition for a single queue.
claims.quote: You can configure one callback profile per overflow condition for a single queue.

claims.where: What's changing; Scope; controls[2].note; Governance guidance; rationale: impact
claims.claim: The profile is selected for a voice queue whose overflow action is Direct callback.
claims.quote: In Copilot Service admin center, for a voice queue, select Direct callback as the overflow action for any of the conditions. ... In Callback profile, select a callback profile.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Change & support; Governance controls
claims.claim: Microsoft warns that editing or deleting the alternate-number capture agent might break callbacks.
claims.quote: Avoid editing or deleting the AI agent that's configured for taking the alternative number. Any changes to the agent might result in callback not working as expected.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Security & identity; Governance guidance: Before rollout
claims.claim: Using different phone platforms for inbound calls and outbound callbacks prevents initiation and closes the request.
claims.quote: if a customer calls an Azure Communication Services number but the callback uses a Microsoft Teams number, the system doesn't initiate the callback and automatically closes the callback request.

claims.claim: A provisioned Microsoft Copilot Studio agent in the environment is a prerequisite.
claims.quote: Provision the Microsoft Copilot Studio agent in your environment.

claims.claim: Phone numbers with outbound calling enabled are a prerequisite.
claims.quote: Configure phone numbers with outbound calling enabled.

claims.claim: Administrators must create any Copilot Studio agents they plan to use for verification or information collection.
claims.quote: Create any Copilot Studio agents that you plan to use for customer verification or information collection.
